call_purpose: Your custom domain had been showing "site can't be reached" for three days, while your funnel worked on the FlexiFunnels link but not on your own domain.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you deleted the old A record at your domain registrar, which pointed to an old server address and was blocking the connection, and added a CNAME record using the target value from your FlexiFunnels domain settings; the dashboard then showed your domain as connected and you confirmed it loads.

Following our guidance, you deleted a second record for the www version that pointed somewhere else and added a CNAME record for www with the same target value, and you confirmed that both your domain and the www version now load your funnel.

covered.text: We explained that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting.

support_next_steps.text: We will check that the secure certificate has been issued, and we will message you if it has not.
support_next_steps.timeline: tomorrow morning (the morning after the call)

omitted_item_ids.reason: diagnostic step with no outcome for the customer
